patreon.title: Git add: Choose the Content for Your Next Commit
patreon.post:
A checkout-button fix and an unfinished experiment can exist together in your working files. Staging lets you prepare the fix while leaving the experiment outside the next commit. You may select whole files or selected changes within a file.

The timing matters: the index holds content from the moment you add it. Stage later edits to the same file again if you want them included.

Takeaway: add prepares content; commit records it. Adding does not upload.

Source: https://git-scm.com/docs/git-add

What would you put in one focused commit?
